A small fix for the Linux / WSL updater.

**Fixes**
- **Linux / WSL:** the in-app updater failed with "Failed to open file /tmp/ProceduralFxStudio-x86_64.flatpak". The sandbox's `/tmp` is private, so the downloaded update is now saved in the app's cache folder instead, where Flatpak can install it.

**Updating from 0.3.0 or earlier on Linux / WSL:** the updater in those versions has this bug, so install 0.3.1 by hand once:
```sh
curl -LO https://github.com/loksangho/proceduralfx-studio/releases/download/v0.3.1/ProceduralFxStudio-x86_64.flatpak
flatpak install --user --reinstall ./ProceduralFxStudio-x86_64.flatpak
```
After that, updates install from inside the app. macOS isn't affected.

See [0.3.0](https://github.com/loksangho/proceduralfx-studio/releases/tag/v0.3.0) for Boolean, terrain, Attribute VOP and the configurable workspace.
